pattern_description: Multi-card syndicate operating through shared device profile (Unknown (desktop)) across 72 distinct cards and 72 customers, operating behind an anonymous proxy and linked to 561 prior closed fraud cases.
sar_narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-009
Subject Customer: C08299 | Subject Card: C08299-K1
Activity Period: 2016-12-28 17:10:53 | Cumulative Exposure: $30.02
Primary Typology: UNDOCUMENTED

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
Financial institution automated graph surveillance identified organized anomalous activity involving customer C08299 and card C08299-K1, resulting in cumulative suspicious exposure of $30.02 across transaction(s) 3581141.

2. GRAPH & DEVICE TOPOLOGY ANALYSIS:
Graph traversal revealed that transaction 3581141 originated from device profile 'Unknown (desktop)' (Device ID: DEV_cc474b994408). Graph topological queries confirmed this exact device profile is shared across 72 distinct cardholder accounts and is connected to 561 previously confirmed fraud case(s) (CC-2404, CC-4571, CC-4002, CC-2865). Activity exhibited proxy masking characteristics (Proxy status: ).

3. POLICY COMPLIANCE & ACTIONS TAKEN:
In accordance with Fraud Policy v1.0 (Rules R6, R8, R9), the institution initiated immediate defensive card blocks, escalated the case to Senior Fraud Management (Level 2 Approval), and filed this formal FinCEN SAR.

evidence.claim: Device profile (Unknown (desktop)) is shared across 72 cards and 72 distinct customers, linked to 561 historical fraud cases (CC-2404, CC-4571, CC-4002)

containment_steps: Immediate hard block on primary compromised card C08299-K1
Identify and freeze all companion cards sharing device profile across graph
Add device hardware fingerprint and proxy IP ranges to real-time blacklists
Revoke active web/mobile banking sessions for affected accounts

customer_communication.message_copy: Dear Cardholder, we detected unauthorized activity on your card ending in 9-K1. For your security, we have placed a hold on the card. A fraud specialist will contact you to reissue a new card.

financial_remediation: Issue provisional credit to affected cardholder(s)
Waive all associated late fees or overdraft charges
compliance_actions: File FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) under Rule R9 (Organized Proxy Syndicate)
Escalate case dossier to Senior Fraud Operations & Legal Compliance (Level 2 Approval)
Write finalized investigation dossier and syndicate links back to TigerGraph
